'''Gawyn Arden''' was a descendent of [[Deredith Arden]], founder of [[Salis D'aar/Legends|Salis D'aar]] on [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. A vocal opponent of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Arden was arrested by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Wilek Nereus]] during a purge of the [[Bakuran]] government. Tortured by [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]], Arden did not survive despite the best efforts of Medical Supervisor [[Sena Pakkallo]].
